resources.string: TBS5530 firmware

Before opening the TBS5530, choose your own firmware file. Obtain it lawfully from the official TBS Linux driver/firmware package on tbsdtv.com, following its license terms. Extract the package first and select dvb-usb-id5530.fw (not the archive). This app does not include or download firmware.
Required size: exactly %1$d bytes\nSHA-256: %2$s

The app validates the size and SHA-256 before replacing the saved copy. The private file tbs5530-firmware.bin is stored in app no_backup storage, excluded from Android backups. No broad storage permission is required. Selecting a file does not open or program the tuner. Delete removes only this app’s copy, not your original file; disconnect the tuner before replacing or deleting firmware.

When you later open the tuner, Android may ask for USB permission twice: once for its initial connection and again after firmware loading, when the device reconnects. Check the TBS5530 and approve each prompt yourself. The file picker is separate from these USB permissions. No root or automatic permission approval is used.
